name: 🧩 Pluggable Chrome Architecture
description:
Approved coordination, 2026-10-25: P067 is the shared UI authoring foundation. T517 owns generic parts/templates; T398 follows it and owns the open widget registry and plain native/described public APIs, including standalone Terminal::new("shell"). P094 consumes that foundation for pane integration; it does not build a second registry or constructor layer. Native Provider/startup regions are public and centrally documented in docs/widgets.md; actual loaded-WASM startup parity remains P022/T075. Completed model/SDK/realizer history stays done, with current source and test evidence separated from unperformed native/plugin runtime acceptance. Preserve T360 review and F012 integration ownership.

Architettura chrome pluggable: `ChromeHost` con regioni left/right/top/bottom, provider built-in, migrazione workspace tree in `WorkspacesContainerProvider`, dynamic action registry, host API per actions/overlay/regions, placeholder token system, plugin semplici da config e runtime WASM.

Authoring/documentation clarification — Antonio, 2026-10-27: document extension identity, named resource lookup and registrations explicitly in docs/extending-heca.md, with widget-specific details in docs/widgets.md. An Extension declares an owner namespace; it is not a widget memoization mechanism. Current Terminal named lookup creates a declaration on first use and shares the session on later requests; action/layer registration has different semantics. P067/T398 carries the concrete clarification and migration review. The documentation change is WIP in feat/t398-widget-api, not yet merged; this note does not approve a new anonymous-identity/lifecycle design or claim it implemented.

T398 constructor review: see phase accepted decision60dbc375-20fb-4630-b51c-fcccd1a6d387. Antonio selected named get-or-create Terminal::new("shell"); its native implementation/docs are WIP in feat/t398-widget-api, aligned to main1c74bdf3. Registry migration still awaits its own design review.
